name: webnews-platform
description: WebNEWS — Pulse of the Public. Root convenience scripts; backend/ and frontend/ are independent apps.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && npm --prefix backend run db:migrate
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.typecheck: npm run check:shared && npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
